options.npc_answer: I just escaped with: [inventory_list]. You look like you've seen better days too. See, I have some good stuff here if you needed.

options.player_question: What was it like when the Plague first hit?
options.npc_answer: It was chaos. The news said it was a new flu. Then people started bleeding from their eyes. Rio was a warzone in three days.

options.player_question: Why did Brazil fall so fast?
options.npc_answer: Carnival, my friend. Millions of people, sweaty and packed together. The perfect breeding ground for the Plague. The government tried to lock us down, but it was too late.
